wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-: The caption text for the table on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that shows revisions that have been flagged for review.
Accessible label for the list of flag tabs on [[Special:AbuseReview]].

Label of the tab on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that shows revisions flagged as containing personal information. Keep short.
{{Identical|Personal information}}

Label of the tab on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that shows revisions flagged as vandalism. Keep short.
{{Identical|Vandalism}}
Introductory text shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]].

Content of a banner shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]] when the user has clicked an Echo notification about flagged edits likely containing personal info that need review. The banner gives them a way to return to the default view of the page.

Parameters:
* $1 - The number of edits shown on the page
* $2 - The number of of edits shown if the user clicks on the link
* $3 - the link to [[Special:AbuseReview]] that returns them to the default view of the queue. The link text is {{msg-mw|wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-echo-notification-banner-link}}.
The link text for a link that returns the user to the default view of [[Special:AbuseReview]]. Used in {{msg-mw|wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-echo-notification-banner}}.
A filter that when checked shows revisions that were manually reviewed and considered a false positive.
A filter that when checked also shows revisions that have already been handled (suppressed or marked as needing no further action), in addition to the pending revisions.
Help text shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]] explaining what the {{msg-mw|wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-show-handled-revisions}} filter does.
The submit button for the form on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that allows filtering the revisions that are shown.
The legend text for the form on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that allows filtering the revisions that are shown.
The label for a button that closes the filter dialog on [[Special:AbuseReview]].
The label for a button that opens the filter dialog on [[Special:AbuseReview]].
The label for the group of checkboxes in the [[Special:AbuseReview]] filter dialog that add normally hidden revisions to the list, such as handled revisions and false positives.
The label for a field in the [[Special:AbuseReview]] filter dialog that allows filtering for flagged revisions performed by any of the specified accounts.
Placeholder text for a field in the [[Special:AbuseReview]] filter dialog that allows filtering for flagged revisions performed by any of the specified accounts.
The label for a field in the [[Special:AbuseReview]] filter dialog that allows filtering for flagged revisions made on the specified pages.
Placeholder text for a field in the [[Special:AbuseReview]] filter dialog that allows filtering for flagged revisions made on the specified pages.
The label for a field in the [[Special:AbuseReview]] filter dialog that allows filtering for flagged revisions with the specified revision IDs.
Placeholder text for a field in the [[Special:AbuseReview]] filter dialog that allows filtering for flagged revisions with the specified revision IDs.
Error message shown in the [[Special:AbuseReview]] filter dialog when the user enters a non-integer value in the revision ID field.
Column heading on [[Special:AbuseReview]] for the column that shows the page a flagged edit was made to and the user who made it.
Column heading on [[Special:AbuseReview]] for the column that shows the flag an edit was tagged with, and the buttons that record a verdict on that flag. Each row shows one flag.
Column heading on [[Special:AbuseReview]] for the column that shows the timestamp the revision was made at, which is linked to the revision itself.
Shown inside the table on [[Special:AbuseReview]] when no revisions are waiting for review.
First line of the body text shown under {{msg-mw|Wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-empty-title}}, stating that the queue is empty. Rendered on a line of its own.
Second line of the body text shown under {{msg-mw|Wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-empty-title}}, explaining how rows get here. Rendered on a line of its own.

Label for the control on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that expands a row to show the actions, edit summary and diff for that edit.
{{Identical|Show details}}

Label for the control on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that collapses an expanded row. Shown in place of {{msg-mw|Wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-show-details}}.
{{Identical|Hide details}}
Heading on [[Special:AbuseReview]] above the links for acting on the flagged revision itself, such as suppressing or reverting it.

Heading above the edit summary of a flagged edit on [[Special:AbuseReview]], rendered on a line of its own.
{{Identical|Edit summary}}
Heading above the diff of a flagged edit on [[Special:AbuseReview]].
Label for the link on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that opens the full diff of a flagged edit in a new tab.

Shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]] in place of the diff of a flagged edit that is too long to show on a page of many rows. The link named by {{msg-mw|wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-open-full-diff}} is shown beside it.
Label of the progress indicator shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]] while an action started from a row is still running. Not shown on screen; it names the progress indicator for assistive technology.

Label for the link on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that opens the page history, where a user holding the suppressrevision right selects the revisions to suppress. The ellipsis indicates that a further step is needed.
Label for the link on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that opens [[Special:RevisionDelete]] for the flagged revision. The ellipsis indicates that a further step is needed.
Label for the link on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that opens the edit form preloaded with an undo of the flagged revision.
Label for the button on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that marks a revision's abuse review flag as a false positive.
Label for the button on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that undoes marking a revision's abuse review flag as a false positive, restoring the original flag.
Label for the button on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that marks a flagged revision as reviewed and needing no further action.
Label for the button on [[Special:AbuseReview]] that removes the no-further-action marking from a revision, putting it back in the review queue.
Shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]] when a reviewer hovers a verdict button on a row whose details are hidden. Only the open row can be judged, so that the reviewer sees the edit first.
Note shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]] beside the disabled action, for a revision that has already been handled by suppressing its text.

Byline shown beside a review verdict on [[Special:AbuseReview]], naming the user who recorded it.

Parameters:
* $1 - the username of the user who recorded the verdict, supplied for {{GENDER:}} only and never shown
* $2 - a link to that user's page

Byline shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]] beside a flagged revision whose verdict was removed, naming the user who sent the revision back for review.

Parameters:
* $1 - the username of the user who sent the revision back for review, supplied for {{GENDER:}} only and never shown
* $2 - a link to that user's page
Error shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]] when marking or unmarking a revision as a false positive fails.
A permission error message shown on [[Special:AbuseReview]] when the user does not have any of the permissions needed to view the page.
